name: _placeholders.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _placeholders.scss — @extend-only blocks shared across stylesheets:
//  %RESETBTN (button reset), %MAXAREA (max-width content column + responsive
//  gutters — the site's main layout constraint), and the skeleton surface.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Reset buttons

/// Bare-button reset — removes UA chrome (background, border, outline,
/// padding) plus the iOS tap highlight; extended by every icon-only or
/// custom-styled control.
%RESETBTN {
  background-color: transparent;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0;
  user-select: none;

  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

/// The site's main layout constraint — full-width content column whose
/// horizontal padding IS the grid gutter per breakpoint. Iterates
/// $grid-steps via the `grid-steps` mixin so the content gutters and the
/// show-grid debug overlay always read the same table.
%MAXAREA {
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  // Gutter = the step's $gap — ($un-$step − $grid-max-area-$step) / 2
  // resolves to exactly the gap token, so padding IS the gutter.
  padding: 0 to-rem($gap-272) 0;

  // One media query per $grid-steps entry — the overlay reads the same map
  // via `grid-steps`, so content gutters and the debug grid never drift.
  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    padding: 0 to-rem($gap) 0;
  }
}

.max-area {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

// Skeleton placeholders on dark surfaces: lift the local dark tone toward
// white instead of mixing the global light surface. The resolved --skel-bg-*
// custom properties are declared here (not derived from --skel-surface)
// because color-mix() inside a custom property is evaluated where the
// property is declared — descendants would otherwise inherit :root values.

/// Dark-surface skeleton palette — redefines --skel-bg-*/--skel-ink as
/// color-mix() lifts of --bg-dark toward white. The vars are redeclared
/// (not derived from --skel-surface) because color-mix() inside a custom
/// property resolves at the declaration site — descendants would
/// otherwise inherit the :root light-surface values.
%SKEL_DARK_SURFACE {
  --skel-bg-1: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 90%, var(--color-white-raw) 10%);
  --skel-bg-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 78%, var(--color-white-raw) 22%);
  --skel-bg-3: var(--skel-bg-1);
  --skel-ink: var(--color-white-raw);
}
